families.note: Product pages give the instantaneous band 8 x In +/- 20 % but no operating time, no time-current gates and no let-through energy.

families.name: Bussmann series 10 x 38 mm cylindrical fuses gG
families.note: Product pages give no time-current data or I2t. Fig. H10 of the cited guide covers 4 < In < 16 A and 16 < In <= 63 A, so no conventional fusing current is cited for 16 A.
